global: A bowl of spicy ramen broth, rich and orange-red, glistens with translucent noodles and fresh cilantro. White bean sprouts and green herbs crown the center, all nestled in a white bowl against a warm, yellow background under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Yellow-orange surface with subtle texture and faint scratches, featuring a small dark screw near the bottom right.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface and thin, curved rim stained with orange residue.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is orange-red, translucent, and glossy, swirling with thin noodles and fresh cilantro.
